subject: Trading
title: Revenge Trading
description: A fast breakdown of Revenge Trading for builders.

hook.text: You just lost $2,000. Angry, you jump into a bigger trade to make it back. You lose $4,000. That's revenge trading.

buildup.text: Revenge trading is emotionally driven re-entry after a loss, with larger size and less analysis.

discovery.text: The desire to 'get back to even' hijacks rational thinking. The market becomes a personal enemy to defeat.

twist.text: The market doesn't know you lost. It doesn't owe you a recovery. Each trade is independent of the last.

climax.text: A mandatory cooling-off rule—30 minutes away from the screen after a loss—prevents most revenge trades.

punchline.text: Step away. The market will be there tomorrow.

quiz.question: What is revenge trading?
options: Trading for revenge against a company
Emotionally driven re-entry after a loss to recover money
